title: Chapter 205 Mechanical Puppet
content:
Chapter 205 Mechanical Puppet

"Jie, Jie..." Dr. Jia laughed strangely from his leaky mouth.

Suddenly, a large number of mechanical puppets rushed out from several passages in this laboratory.

Some were humanoid and some were beastoid, and they quickly surrounded Wang Shuo and others.

"Are you competing for more people? Then let you test whether these test products are useful or not!"

Wang Shuo took a look and found that these mechanical puppets were between level 20 and 30, but their durability was ridiculously high, about 10,000.

At the same time, their defense was also good, especially those that exuded a metallic luster, which had a defense of an astonishing 250, which was higher than Wang Shuo's defense.

Suddenly, the melee mode was turned on.

There were about 20 puppets.

Ordinary soldiers could barely deal with one with a few people.

Wang Shuo held a spear in his hand and picked a crocodile puppet.

He had a deep affection for animals like crocodiles, even if the other party was just a puppet.

But today was different. Wang Shuo took a step forward and stabbed the crocodile's head with his spear.

Wang Shuo's current strength attribute, including the additional attributes of the equipment and the 20% bonus of the general, has reached 135 points, which gave him great confidence.

With one move, the spear sank into the mouth of the crocodile puppet and swallowed half of the spear body.

Another three-combo skill.

Fire began to emerge in the crocodile's stomach.

Although the crocodile puppet has a high surface defense, its mouth and stomach are full of power devices, and its defense is basically zero.

The internal structure is destroyed, and no matter how hard the shell is, it is no longer effective.

The durability has dropped all the way from 9000. When the imprisonment skill ends, the durability is directly reset to zero.

In just a few breaths, Wang Shuo has dealt with a puppet.

Wang Shuo looked up.

Gong Zheng directly turned into a giant and pressed a 3-meter-tall gorilla puppet to the ground and beat it wildly.

A mighty King Kong was now pressed to the ground by him and rubbed hard.

And Ayub was also attacking a humanoid puppet crazily.

The biggest problem with these puppets is that they are not as fast as everyone else.

It's not that these puppets are slow, but the agility of Wang Shuo and others is too high at this level.

At the same time, Locke, Shi Lisha and others can only be said to have the upper hand.

Wang Shuo's eyes keenly discovered Ye Xueer.

She was fighting a wolf-shaped puppet on equal terms.

She was holding a long sword, and a faint milky white light was emitted from the sword. The long sword cut across and blocked the bite of the puppet wolf, but the long sword was also bitten by the wolf.

She slapped her left hand, bringing out a palm wind, hitting the wolf's head, pushing the puppet wolf back two steps, and the long sword broke free from the wolf's mouth.

Wang Shuo was stunned, this was a fighting method he had never seen before.

The main thing was, what exactly was the milky white light on the sword? Could it be some kind of talisman?

Like the one used by Wang Yanbing?

Before he could think about it, Wang Shuo was entangled by another puppet and had to fight seriously.

After more than ten minutes, all the puppets had been destroyed.

Many people were injured, especially ordinary soldiers.

Wang Shuo ordered his soldiers to retreat outside the battlefield and attack Dr. Jia. Ordinary soldiers were no longer useful.

Because their attacks could not break Dr. Jia's 500-point defense.

Even Wang Shuo could not break the defense with ordinary attacks.

Fortunately, Dr. Jia's health points were not too high.
